title: Getting started — well-known public infrastructure
description: Seed indicators that are public, long-lived and unremarkable, so you can see what real DNS, RDAP, Team Cymru and certificate-transparency results look like. Nothing here is pre-computed or fabricated: every observation is fetched live when you run the enrichment, and an unreachable source shows up as an explicit gap.

indicators.note: IANA-reserved example domain. Good for seeing the DNS, RDAP and CT views end to end.
A well-known public DNS resolver address. Shows reverse DNS with forward confirmation, RDAP network ownership and the origin AS.
An autonomous system number. Shows RDAP AS registration and the AS name lookup.

notes: Registry country on IPs and ASNs is where the block was allocated, not where hosts physically are.
Compare the 'Verified' and 'Provider claim' badges: DNS and RDAP come straight from the source of record, while Team Cymru and crt.sh are third-party aggregators.
